name: metaforge
description: Engineer hardware against a digital twin: requirements, CAD, simulation and evidence, with writes held for human approval.

gateway_url.title: Gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Your MetaForge gateway's MCP endpoint. Leave the default if you are running one locally; enter your team or hosted URL otherwise.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Only needed for a gateway that requires one. A local gateway started with no auth configured does not.

tool_profile.title: Tool profile
tool_profile.description: Which tool set to load. all (the default) loads every tool: Claude Code defers tools behind its tool search, and a client-mode run needs phase, gate, CAD, simulation and value-sourcing tools together, which no capped set holds. On a harness with a hard tool limit pick a capped set instead: core (project, twin reads, decisions, flows), client_run (drive a client-mode run and source values; reads the machine library), mechanical (stateless CAD), mechanical_product (CAD authored in a FreeCAD session), manufacturing (process selection and DFM review; reads the machine library), industrial_design (form factor, ergonomics and finishes; renders and the appearance library), simulation, electronics or robotics, each 25-40 tools. Registering, discovering or sending a job to a machine needs all. Every set includes health.check so /metaforge:doctor always works.
